item.title: Oregon’s most expensive old house listing! Ranch on 51,000 acres. $54,580,000
item.description: Welcome to Oregon’s most expensive old house listing! This is a beautiful ranch. I can’t imagine having that much acreage. The main house was built in 1921. It is located on 51,087 acres in Madras, Oregon. There is an additional 15,000 of BLM grazing permits. There are multiple buildings on the property, including ranch hand houses, a dance hall, chapel and multiple barns. Four bedrooms, three bathrooms and 4,652 square feet. $54,580,000 From the Zillow listing: Spanning over 51,087 deeded acres

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! Ten acres in NC with outbuildings and a cemetery. $160,000
item.description: Fixer upper alert! Nice acreage and it has a small cemetery. The house was built in 1840. It is located on 10.1 acres in Pendleton, North Carolina. The house features double front doors, wood floors, wainscoting, wide baseboards, crown moulding and chair rails. There are multiple outbuildings and they say there is a small cemetery near one of them. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,900 square feet. $160,000 Contact Phil Rawlings with Wilkie Real Estate From the Zillow listing: “SHORT SALE!! SH

item.title: Pretty setting and woodwork! Five acres in Illinois. $299,000
item.description: This house has a private setting and unpainted woodwork. The house was built in 1950. It is located on 5.15 acres in Chestnut, Illinois. The house features a screened in front porch, wood floors, built-in bookshelves, crown moulding, baseboards, arched entryway and solid wood doors. There are multiple outbuildings on the property. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,051 square feet. $299,000 Contact Seth A. Goodman with ME Realty: 217-737-3742 From the Zillow listing: Sensational 4-bedroom, 2 ful

item.title: Pennsylvania’s most expensive old house listing! Yolanda Hadid’s home. C. 1780. $10,888,000
item.description: Welcome to Pennsylvania’s most expensive old house listing! We are usually all curious about who owns these estates. This one was owned by Yolanda Hadid. The house was built in 1780. It is located on 32 acres in New Hope, Pennsylvania. The property features a main house, corn crib cottage, three guest cottages, lavender farm, pool and equestrian facilities. Check out all of her Hermes bags in the closet. Seven bedrooms, eight bathrooms and 6,907 square feet. $10,888,000 From the Zillow listing:

item.title: Storybook cottage! Beautiful area! Two acres in North Carolina. $369,000
item.description: This house sure looks like a storybook cottage! Such a great area too! The house was built in 1930. It is located on 2.13 acres in Brevard, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, back deck, wood ceilings, sunroom, built-in bookshelves and an updated bathroom. Outside you will find established gardens. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 862 square feet. $369,000 Contact Matthew Durt with Looking Glass Realty: matthew@lookingglassrealty.com From the Zillow listing: Tucked away at th

item.title: What a house this could be! “Oak Hill”, Circa 1840. Over two acres in Virginia. $399,000
item.description: What a project and house this could be! I hope it doesn’t get muddled up by a new owner. Known as Oak Hill. The house was built in 1840. It is located on 2.4 acres in Surry, Virginia. The house and land has some amazing history. It was once part of the dowry given by Chief Powhatan to John Rolfe upon his marriage to Matoaka (Pocahontas). The house has original features! item.title: Look inside! Nice details! C. 1886 in Kansas. $177,000
item.description: Take a look inside! This house has some really nice features! The house was built in 1886. It is located on .31 acre in Great Bend, Kansas. The house features a small covered front porch, a covered side porch, original wood floors, beautiful mantels, chair rails, pocket doors, wide baseboards, stained glass and an updated kitchen. Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,982 square feet. $177,000 Contact Linda K. Ludes with Results Realty: 620-791-8223 From the Zillow listing: Priced to sell at $177,0

item.title: Maximalism! Take a look inside! 14 acres in Louisiana. $1,325,000
item.description: Talk about maximalism! That is this house! The home was built in 1830 by Charles Stewart. The land was once gifted by Thomas Jefferson to Marquis de Lafayette. The home is situated on 14 acres in Batchelor, Louisiana. The house features a grand staircase, soaring ceilings, wood floors, double porches, wide baseboards, pretty chandeliers and crown moulding. The house is on the banks of the Old River. Eleven bedrooms, four bathrooms and 11,270 square feet. $1,325,000 Contact Rhett Sandusky with Ke

item.title: Huge barn! Loads of potential! On 1 1/2 acres in Maine. $395,000
item.description: I don’t think I have ever seen such a big barn that is attached! The house was built in 1900. It is located on 1.5 acres in China, Maine. The house features shake shingle siding, wide plank wood floors, nice staircase, large kitchen space, chair rails, big fireplace and a huge attached barn. There is a detached guest cottage on the property. Not far from China Lake for boating and swimming. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,183 square feet. $395,000 Contact Tim Dunham with Tim Dunham Realty: 20

item.title: Great stove! Quaint house! Almost an acre in Michigan. $174,500
item.description: How about that stove?! The interior looks quaint! The house was built in 1880. It is located on .89 acre in Gobles, Michigan. The house features an enclosed front porch, original wood floors, vintage light fixtures wide baseboards, wainscoting and french doors. The antique stove in the kitchen is beautiful! Four bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,899 square feet. $174,500 Contact Diane L. Vandenberg with Lakes and Country Real Estate: 269-207-9599 From the Zillow listing: Custom woodwork and quality
